title: Conditional polling, ETag/version checks and state freshness are not consistently implemented

original_titles.title: Boot gaps: no /config.json, single-sample clock sync, no X-Min-Client-Version gate
Polling deviations: fixed intervals, no jitter/backoff/visibility/online triggers; leaderboard not version-gated
No flags/maintenance in /v1/state and no P-24 maintenance page
/state polls at a fixed 5 s even outside an active round
Leaderboard snapshot cutoff uses the app server clock

problem: State and leaderboard clients still rely on fixed polling and app-server time for some cutoff logic. The API does not consistently expose ETag/If-None-Match or version-based not-modified semantics; repository search is bounded without a cursor, and maintenance/feature flags are not fully represented in /state.
impact: Clients request unchanged data repeatedly and can display stale or inconsistent state after sleep/network transitions. Server-side load increases during synchronized refresh periods.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Add monotonic state_version/leaderboard_version values updated transactionally on relevant changes.
Support ETag or since_version on state, leaderboard and repository search responses. Return 304 or a compact not-modified response when unchanged.
Use DB time for leaderboard cutoffs and state transitions; do not use application host time for authoritative competition deadlines.
Use polling only while an event is active/visible; apply jittered backoff while hidden/offline and refetch on visibility/online transitions.
Add cursor pagination for search and test version changes, no-change responses, sleep/wake, network reconnect and synchronized client load.

acceptance_criteria: Unchanged state/leaderboard does not send a full response on each poll.
Version increments atomically on state change.
Hidden/offline clients back off and reconcile correctly when visible/online.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
